```{r multirun full}
# STEP 2 - Full pipeline
    # 2.1 wrap multirun chunk, to multi-run :) 
      run_compass_pipeline <- function(
          p1_constraints, p1_groups, p1_microdata,
          p2_constraints, p2_groups, p2_microdata,
          results_dir, n,
          start_run = 1, restart = TRUE, restart_from = NULL, save_every = 1
      ) {

        state_file <- file.path(results_dir, "analysis_state.RData")

        dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings=FALSE)
        dir.create(file.path(results_dir, "checkpoints"), recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
        dir.create(file.path(results_dir, "logs"), recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)

        other_vars <- c("hh_urban_rural", "hh_heating", "hh_type", "ind_education", "ind_ethnicity", "ind_health")

    # 2.2 define input files 
      p1_con <- file.path(results_dir, "p1_constraints_full.csv")
      p1_grp <- file.path(results_dir, "p1_groups_full.csv")
      p2_con <- file.path(results_dir, "p2_constraints_full.csv")
      p2_grp <- file.path(results_dir, "p2_groups_full.csv")

      write.csv(p1_constraints, p1_con, row.names=FALSE)
      write.csv(p1_groups, p1_grp, row.names=FALSE)
      write.csv(p2_constraints, p2_con, row.names=FALSE)
      write.csv(p2_groups, p2_grp, row.names=FALSE)

    # 2.3 check headers
      get_micro_headers <- function(file) names(read.csv(file, nrows=1, check.names=FALSE))
      check_headers <- function(con, grp, micro, label, id_cols = c("LSOA21CD", "population")) {

        con_h <- setdiff(names(con), id_cols)
        grp_h <- grp$heading
        micro_h <- setdiff(micro, "hidp")

        cat("\n", label, " INPUT CHECK\n", sep="")
        cat("========================================\n")
        cat("Constraints: ", length(con_h), "\n", sep="")
        cat("Groups: ", length(grp_h), "\n", sep="")
        cat("Microdata variables: ", length(micro_h), "\n", sep="")

        missing_grp <- setdiff(con_h, grp_h)
        extra_grp <- setdiff(grp_h, con_h)
        missing_micro <- setdiff(con_h, micro_h)
        extra_micro <- setdiff(micro_h, con_h)

        if(length(missing_grp)>0) {
          cat("\nConstraints missing from groups:\n")
          print(missing_grp)
          stop(label, " constraints/groups mismatch")
        }

        if(length(extra_grp)>0) {
          cat("\nGroups not present in constraints:\n")
          print(extra_grp)
          stop(label, " groups/constraints mismatch")
        }

        if(length(missing_micro)>0) {
          cat("\nConstraints missing from microdata:\n")
          print(missing_micro)
          stop(label, " microdata/constraints mismatch")
        }

        if(length(extra_micro)>0) {
          cat("\nIgnoring microdata-only variables:\n")
          print(extra_micro)
        }

        cat("\n", label, " header SETS OK\n", sep="")

    # 2.4 enforce colunmn order 
      # Target order: id columns first (in their existing order), then
      # constraint/microdata variables in the order the MICRODATA declares them
      # (microdata is the more constrained/authoritative source here, since it's
      # what actually gets read row-by-row by the household lookup logic).
      target_var_order <- micro_h[micro_h %in% con_h]
      current_var_order <- names(con)[names(con) %in% con_h]
      order_matches <- identical(current_var_order, target_var_order)

      if (!order_matches) {

        first_mismatch <- which(current_var_order != target_var_order)[1]

        cat("\n", label, " COLUMN ORDER MISMATCH detected.\n", sep="")
        cat("First divergence at position ", first_mismatch, ":\n", sep="")
        cat("  constraints has:  ", current_var_order[first_mismatch], "\n", sep="")
        cat("  microdata has:    ", target_var_order[first_mismatch], "\n", sep="")
        cat("Reordering constraints columns to match microdata order...\n")

        con <- data.table::setcolorder(
          data.table::copy(data.table::as.data.table(con)),
          neworder = c(id_cols[id_cols %in% names(con)], target_var_order)
        )
        con <- as.data.frame(con)

        # Re-verify after reordering 
        reordered_var_order <- names(con)[names(con) %in% con_h]
        if (!identical(reordered_var_order, target_var_order)) {
          stop(label, ": column reordering failed to align constraints with microdata. ",
              "Check for duplicate column names or unexpected id_cols.")
        }

        cat(label, " columns reordered to match microdata. Order now OK.\n", sep="")

      } else {
        cat(label, " column ORDER already matches microdata. OK.\n", sep="")
      }

      # write/use the corrected version, not the original.
      invisible(con)
      }

      p1_micro_headers <- get_micro_headers(p1_microdata)
      p2_micro_headers <- get_micro_headers(p2_microdata)

      p1_constraints <- check_headers(p1_constraints, p1_groups, p1_micro_headers, "P1")
      p2_constraints <- check_headers(p2_constraints, p2_groups, p2_micro_headers, "P2")

      write.csv(p1_constraints, p1_con, row.names=FALSE)
      write.csv(p2_constraints, p2_con, row.names=FALSE)

    # 2.5 Microdata/lookup matrix set up
      p1_micro_df <- read.csv(p1_microdata, check.names=FALSE)
      p2_micro_df <- read.csv(p2_microdata, check.names=FALSE)

      if(sum(duplicated(p1_micro_df$hidp))>0) stop("Duplicate hidp values in P1 microdata.")
      if(sum(duplicated(p2_micro_df$hidp))>0) stop("Duplicate hidp values in P2 microdata.")

      age_bands <- c("00_15", "16_24", "25_34", "35_49", "50_64", "65p")
      sex_bands <- c("f", "m")

      dis_cols <- names(p1_micro_df)[grepl("^ind_sex_age_dis%", names(p1_micro_df))]
      dis1_cols <- dis_cols[grepl("_dis1$", dis_cols)]
      dis0_cols <- dis_cols[grepl("_dis0$", dis_cols)]

      hh_level_prefixes <- c("hh_urban_rural", "hh_heating", "hh_type")
      hh_level_cols <- names(p1_micro_df)[sapply(strsplit(names(p1_micro_df), "%"), function(x) x[1]) %in% hh_level_prefixes]

      needed_cols <- c(dis1_cols, dis0_cols, hh_level_cols)

      p1_lookup_mat <- as.matrix(p1_micro_df[, needed_cols, drop=FALSE])
      p2_lookup_mat <- as.matrix(p2_micro_df[, needed_cols, drop=FALSE])

      rownames(p1_lookup_mat) <- as.character(p1_micro_df$hidp)
      rownames(p2_lookup_mat) <- as.character(p2_micro_df$hidp)

    # 2.6 define helper functions (CIs and prevalence)
      prevalence_weighted <- function(mat, idx, counts, dis1_cols_sub, dis0_cols_sub) {
        if(length(idx)==0 || length(c(dis1_cols_sub, dis0_cols_sub))==0) {
          return(data.frame(dis1_count=0, pop_count=0, prevalence=NA_real_))
        }
        cols <- c(dis1_cols_sub, dis0_cols_sub)
        sub <- mat[idx, cols, drop=FALSE] * counts
        dis1_n <- sum(sub[, dis1_cols_sub, drop=FALSE], na.rm=TRUE)
        pop_n <- sum(sub, na.rm=TRUE)
        data.frame(dis1_count=dis1_n, pop_count=pop_n, prevalence=ifelse(pop_n>0, dis1_n/pop_n, NA_real_))
      }

      ci_from_runs <- function(x) {
        x <- x[!is.na(x)]
        if(length(x)<2) return(c(ci_low=NA_real_, ci_high=NA_real_))
        q <- quantile(x, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=TRUE)
        c(ci_low=unname(q[1]), ci_high=unname(q[2]))
      }

      census_prevalence <- function(constraints_df, dis1_cols_sub, dis0_cols_sub) {
        dis1_cols_sub <- intersect(dis1_cols_sub, names(constraints_df))
        dis0_cols_sub <- intersect(dis0_cols_sub, names(constraints_df))
        if(length(dis1_cols_sub)==0 || length(dis0_cols_sub)==0) {
          return(data.frame(dis1_count=NA_real_, pop_count=NA_real_, prevalence=NA_real_))
        }
        dis1_n <- sum(as.matrix(constraints_df[, dis1_cols_sub, drop=FALSE]), na.rm=TRUE)
        dis0_n <- sum(as.matrix(constraints_df[, dis0_cols_sub, drop=FALSE]), na.rm=TRUE)
        pop_n <- dis1_n + dis0_n
        data.frame(dis1_count=dis1_n, pop_count=pop_n, prevalence=ifelse(pop_n>0, dis1_n/pop_n, NA_real_))
      }

    # 2.7 census ground truth set up 
      p1_census_stat <- census_prevalence(p1_constraints, dis1_cols, dis0_cols)
      p2_census_stat <- census_prevalence(p2_constraints, dis1_cols, dis0_cols)

      write.csv(
        data.frame(census_p1_prevalence=p1_census_stat$prevalence, census_p2_target_prevalence=p2_census_stat$prevalence),
        file.path(results_dir, "census_disability_marginal.csv"), row.names=FALSE
      )

      census_sex_dis <- list()
      for(s in sex_bands) {
        d1 <- names(p1_constraints)[grepl(paste0("^ind_sex_age_dis%", s, "_.*_dis1$"), names(p1_constraints))]
        d0 <- names(p1_constraints)[grepl(paste0("^ind_sex_age_dis%", s, "_.*_dis0$"), names(p1_constraints))]
        p1_stat <- census_prevalence(p1_constraints, d1, d0)
        p2_stat <- census_prevalence(p2_constraints, d1, d0)
        census_sex_dis[[s]] <- data.frame(category=s, census_prevalence=p1_stat$prevalence, p2_target_prevalence=p2_stat$prevalence)
      }
      census_sex_dis <- do.call(rbind, census_sex_dis)
      write.csv(census_sex_dis, file.path(results_dir, "census_sex_x_disability.csv"), row.names=FALSE)

      census_age_dis <- list()
      for(a in age_bands) {
        d1 <- names(p1_constraints)[grepl(paste0("^ind_sex_age_dis%.*_", a, "_dis1$"), names(p1_constraints))]
        d0 <- names(p1_constraints)[grepl(paste0("^ind_sex_age_dis%.*_", a, "_dis0$"), names(p1_constraints))]
        p1_stat <- census_prevalence(p1_constraints, d1, d0)
        p2_stat <- census_prevalence(p2_constraints, d1, d0)
        census_age_dis[[a]] <- data.frame(category=a, census_prevalence=p1_stat$prevalence, p2_target_prevalence=p2_stat$prevalence)
      }
      census_age_dis <- do.call(rbind, census_age_dis)
      write.csv(census_age_dis, file.path(results_dir, "census_age_x_disability.csv"), row.names=FALSE)

    # 2.8 accumulators set up 
      variable_results <- list()
      l1_sex_dis_results <- list()
      l1_age_dis_results <- list()
      l1_dis_marginal_results <- list()
      l1_dis_hh_results <- list()
      l2_worst100_results <- list()
      global_fit_results <- list()
      timing <- list()

    # 2.9 COMPASS function
      run_compass <- function(constraints, microdata, groups, output, validate, seed, log_file, defs = l_definitions) {
        payload <- list(
          constraints = constraints, microdata = microdata, groups = groups,
          output = output, validate = validate,
          initialTemp      = defs$initialTemp,
          minTemp          = defs$minTemp,
          coolingRate      = defs$coolingRate,
          reheatFactor     = defs$reheatFactor,
          fitnessThreshold = defs$fitnessThreshold,
          # minImprovement   = defs$minImprovement,
          maxIterations    = defs$maxIterations,
          windowSize       = defs$windowSize,
          change           = defs$change,
          distance         = defs$distance,
          useRandomSeed    = defs$useRandomSeed,
          randomSeed       = seed
        )
        out <- system2(defs$path_compass, input = toJSON(payload, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = NA), stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
        writeLines(out, log_file)
        if (!file.exists(output) || !file.exists(validate)) stop("Compass failed. See: ", log_file)
        invisible(out)
      }

      extract_marginal <- function(x) {
        required <- c("geography_code", "variable", "synth_fraction")
        if(!all(required %in% names(x))) stop("Validation file does not contain expected columns.")
        out <- x[, required, drop=FALSE]
        out$constraint_fraction <- if("constraint_fraction" %in% names(x)) x$constraint_fraction else NA_real_
        out
      }

    # 2.10 restart state
      if(restart && is.null(restart_from) && file.exists(state_file)) {
        load(state_file)
        start_run <- last_completed_run + 1
      } else {
        start_run <- if(!is.null(restart_from)) restart_from else start_run
        last_completed_run <- start_run - 1
      }

    # 2.11 run main loop 
      for(i in start_run:n) {

        cat("\n[", basename(results_dir), "] RUN ", i, " OF ", n, "\n", sep="")

        seed <- 1000 + i
        run_start <- Sys.time()
        id <- sprintf("%03d", i)

        p1_pop <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("p1_pop_run", id, ".csv"))
        p1_val <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("p1_validate_run", id, ".csv"))
        t1 <- Sys.time()
        run_compass(p1_con, p1_microdata, p1_grp, p1_pop, p1_val, seed, file.path(results_dir, "logs", paste0("P1_run", id, ".log")))
        p1_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t1, units="secs"))

        p2_pop <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("p2_pop_run", id, ".csv"))
        p2_val <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("p2_validate_run", id, ".csv"))
        t2 <- Sys.time()
        run_compass(p2_con, p2_microdata, p2_grp, p2_pop, p2_val, seed, file.path(results_dir, "logs", paste0("P2_run", id, ".log")))
        p2_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t2, units="secs"))

        p1 <- read.csv(p1_val, check.names=FALSE)
        p2 <- read.csv(p2_val, check.names=FALSE)
        p1_m <- extract_marginal(p1); p1_m$match_variable <- p1_m$variable
        p2_m <- extract_marginal(p2); p2_m$match_variable <- p2_m$variable

        m <- merge(p1_m, p2_m, by=c("geography_code", "match_variable"), suffixes=c("_p1", "_p2"))
        if(nrow(m)==0) stop("No matching marginal variables in run ", i)

        m$p2_minus_p1 <- m$synth_fraction_p2 - m$synth_fraction_p1
        m$p2_minus_p1_abs <- abs(m$p2_minus_p1)
        m$p2_minus_p1_squared <- m$p2_minus_p1^2
        m$p1_minus_census <- m$synth_fraction_p1 - m$constraint_fraction_p1
        m$p1_minus_census_abs <- abs(m$p1_minus_census)
        m$p1_minus_census_squared <- m$p1_minus_census^2
        m$p2_minus_census <- m$synth_fraction_p2 - m$constraint_fraction_p1
        m$p2_minus_census_abs <- abs(m$p2_minus_census)
        m$p2_minus_census_squared <- m$p2_minus_census^2

        global_fit_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
          run=i, n_cells=nrow(m),
          mean_p2_minus_p1_abs=mean(m$p2_minus_p1_abs, na.rm=TRUE),
          mean_p2_minus_p1_squared=mean(m$p2_minus_p1_squared, na.rm=TRUE),
          mean_p1_census_abs=mean(m$p1_minus_census_abs, na.rm=TRUE),
          mean_p1_census_squared=mean(m$p1_minus_census_squared, na.rm=TRUE),
          mean_p2_census_abs=mean(m$p2_minus_census_abs, na.rm=TRUE),
          mean_p2_census_squared=mean(m$p2_minus_census_squared, na.rm=TRUE)
        )

        v <- aggregate(
          cbind(p2_minus_p1_abs, p2_minus_p1_squared, p1_minus_census_abs, p1_minus_census_squared,
                p2_minus_census_abs, p2_minus_census_squared) ~ variable_p1,
          data=m, FUN=function(x) c(sum=sum(x, na.rm=TRUE), n=sum(!is.na(x)))
        )
        v <- do.call(data.frame, v)
        names(v) <- gsub("\\.sum$", "_sum", names(v))
        names(v) <- gsub("\\.n$", "_n", names(v))
        names(v)[names(v)=="variable_p1"] <- "variable"
        v$run <- i
        variable_results[[i]] <- v

        p1_ids <- fread(p1_pop, select="microdata_id")[[1]]
        p2_ids <- fread(p2_pop, select="microdata_id")[[1]]
        p1_freq <- table(as.character(p1_ids))
        p2_freq <- table(as.character(p2_ids))
        idx1 <- match(names(p1_freq), rownames(p1_lookup_mat))
        idx2 <- match(names(p2_freq), rownames(p2_lookup_mat))
        if(any(is.na(idx1))) stop("Some P1 population microdata_id values not found in microdata (run ", i, ")")
        if(any(is.na(idx2))) stop("Some P2 population microdata_id values not found in microdata (run ", i, ")")
        counts1 <- as.numeric(p1_freq)
        counts2 <- as.numeric(p2_freq)

        sex_dis_run <- list()
        for(s in sex_bands) {
          d1 <- names(p1_micro_df)[grepl(paste0("^ind_sex_age_dis%", s, "_.*_dis1$"), names(p1_micro_df))]
          d0 <- names(p1_micro_df)[grepl(paste0("^ind_sex_age_dis%", s, "_.*_dis0$"), names(p1_micro_df))]
          p1_stat <- prevalence_weighted(p1_lookup_mat, idx1, counts1, d1, d0)
          p2_stat <- prevalence_weighted(p2_lookup_mat, idx2, counts2, d1, d0)
          census_row <- census_sex_dis[census_sex_dis$category==s, , drop=FALSE]
          census_prev <- if(nrow(census_row)>0) census_row$census_prevalence[1] else NA_real_
          sex_dis_run[[s]] <- data.frame(
            run=i, category=s, census_prevalence=census_prev,
            p1_prevalence=p1_stat$prevalence, p2_prevalence=p2_stat$prevalence,
            p1_minus_census=p1_stat$prevalence-census_prev, p2_minus_census=p2_stat$prevalence-census_prev,
            p2_minus_p1=p2_stat$prevalence-p1_stat$prevalence
          )
        }
        l1_sex_dis_results[[i]] <- do.call(rbind, sex_dis_run)

        age_dis_run <- list()
        for(a in age_bands) {
          d1 <- names(p1_micro_df)[grepl(paste0("^ind_sex_age_dis%.*_", a, "_dis1$"), names(p1_micro_df))]
          d0 <- names(p1_micro_df)[grepl(paste0("^ind_sex_age_dis%.*_", a, "_dis0$"), names(p1_micro_df))]
          p1_stat <- prevalence_weighted(p1_lookup_mat, idx1, counts1, d1, d0)
          p2_stat <- prevalence_weighted(p2_lookup_mat, idx2, counts2, d1, d0)
          census_row <- census_age_dis[census_age_dis$category==a, , drop=FALSE]
          census_prev <- if(nrow(census_row)>0) census_row$census_prevalence[1] else NA_real_
          age_dis_run[[a]] <- data.frame(
            run=i, category=a, census_prevalence=census_prev,
            p1_prevalence=p1_stat$prevalence, p2_prevalence=p2_stat$prevalence,
            p1_minus_census=p1_stat$prevalence-census_prev, p2_minus_census=p2_stat$prevalence-census_prev,
            p2_minus_p1=p2_stat$prevalence-p1_stat$prevalence
          )
        }
        l1_age_dis_results[[i]] <- do.call(rbind, age_dis_run)

        p1_stat <- prevalence_weighted(p1_lookup_mat, idx1, counts1, dis1_cols, dis0_cols)
        p2_stat <- prevalence_weighted(p2_lookup_mat, idx2, counts2, dis1_cols, dis0_cols)
        census_prev <- p1_census_stat$prevalence
        l1_dis_marginal_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
          run=i, census_prevalence=census_prev,
          p1_prevalence=p1_stat$prevalence, p2_prevalence=p2_stat$prevalence,
          p1_minus_census=p1_stat$prevalence-census_prev, p2_minus_census=p2_stat$prevalence-census_prev,
          p2_minus_p1=p2_stat$prevalence-p1_stat$prevalence
        )

        hh_dis_run <- list()
        for(pfx in hh_level_prefixes) {
          cats <- hh_level_cols[grepl(paste0("^", pfx, "%"), hh_level_cols)]
          for(col_name in cats) {
            cat_label <- sub("^.*%", "", col_name)
            mask1 <- p1_lookup_mat[idx1, col_name]==1
            mask2 <- p2_lookup_mat[idx2, col_name]==1
            p1_stat <- prevalence_weighted(p1_lookup_mat, idx1[mask1], counts1[mask1], dis1_cols, dis0_cols)
            p2_stat <- prevalence_weighted(p2_lookup_mat, idx2[mask2], counts2[mask2], dis1_cols, dis0_cols)
            hh_dis_run[[col_name]] <- data.frame(
              run=i, variable=pfx, category=cat_label, census_prevalence=NA_real_,
              p1_prevalence=p1_stat$prevalence, p2_prevalence=p2_stat$prevalence,
              p1_minus_census=NA_real_, p2_minus_census=NA_real_,
              p2_minus_p1=p2_stat$prevalence-p1_stat$prevalence
            )
          }
        }
        l1_dis_hh_results[[i]] <- do.call(rbind, hh_dis_run)

        l2_base <- m[!is.na(m$p1_minus_census_squared), , drop=FALSE]
        if(nrow(l2_base)==0) stop("No P1-vs-census values available for LSOA ranking in run ", i)
        p1_lsoa_score <- aggregate(p1_minus_census_squared ~ geography_code, data=l2_base, FUN=sum, na.rm=TRUE)
        names(p1_lsoa_score)[2] <- "p1_census_squared_error_sum"
        p1_lsoa_score <- p1_lsoa_score[order(-p1_lsoa_score$p1_census_squared_error_sum), , drop=FALSE]
        p1_lsoa_score <- p1_lsoa_score[seq_len(min(100, nrow(p1_lsoa_score))), , drop=FALSE]
        p1_lsoa_score$p1_rank <- seq_len(nrow(p1_lsoa_score))
        worst_codes <- p1_lsoa_score$geography_code

        p1_detail <- l2_base[l2_base$geography_code %in% worst_codes,
          c("geography_code","variable_p1","synth_fraction_p1","p1_minus_census","p1_minus_census_abs","p1_minus_census_squared"), drop=FALSE]
        p2_detail <- m[m$geography_code %in% worst_codes,
          c("geography_code","variable_p1","synth_fraction_p2","p2_minus_census","p2_minus_census_abs","p2_minus_census_squared","p2_minus_p1","p2_minus_p1_abs","p2_minus_p1_squared"), drop=FALSE]

        p1_summary <- aggregate(cbind(p1_minus_census_abs, p1_minus_census_squared) ~ geography_code, data=p1_detail, FUN=sum, na.rm=TRUE)
        names(p1_summary)[2:3] <- c("p1_census_abs_error_sum", "p1_census_squared_error_sum")
        p2_summary <- aggregate(cbind(p2_minus_census_abs, p2_minus_census_squared, p2_minus_p1_abs, p2_minus_p1_squared) ~ geography_code, data=p2_detail, FUN=sum, na.rm=TRUE)
        names(p2_summary)[2:5] <- c("p2_census_abs_error_sum","p2_census_squared_error_sum","p2_p1_abs_error_sum","p2_p1_squared_error_sum")

        p1_top <- p1_detail[order(p1_detail$geography_code, -p1_detail$p1_minus_census_squared), c("geography_code","variable_p1","p1_minus_census"), drop=FALSE]
        p1_top$rank <- ave(seq_len(nrow(p1_top)), p1_top$geography_code, FUN=seq_along)
        p1_top <- p1_top[p1_top$rank<=5, , drop=FALSE]
        p1_top_wide <- dcast(as.data.table(p1_top), geography_code ~ rank, value.var=c("variable_p1","p1_minus_census"))
        setnames(p1_top_wide, old=names(p1_top_wide)[-1], new=c(paste0("p1_top",1:5,"_variable"), paste0("p1_top",1:5,"_error")), skip_absent=TRUE)

        p2_top <- p2_detail[order(p2_detail$geography_code, -p2_detail$p2_minus_census_squared), c("geography_code","variable_p1","p2_minus_census"), drop=FALSE]
        p2_top$rank <- ave(seq_len(nrow(p2_top)), p2_top$geography_code, FUN=seq_along)
        p2_top <- p2_top[p2_top$rank<=5, , drop=FALSE]
        p2_top_wide <- dcast(as.data.table(p2_top), geography_code ~ rank, value.var=c("variable_p1","p2_minus_census"))
        setnames(p2_top_wide, old=names(p2_top_wide)[-1], new=c(paste0("p2_top",1:5,"_variable"), paste0("p2_top",1:5,"_error")), skip_absent=TRUE)

        l2_run <- merge(p1_lsoa_score, p1_summary, by="geography_code", all.x=TRUE)
        l2_run <- merge(l2_run, p2_summary, by="geography_code", all.x=TRUE)
        l2_run <- merge(l2_run, p1_top_wide, by="geography_code", all.x=TRUE)
        l2_run <- merge(l2_run, p2_top_wide, by="geography_code", all.x=TRUE)
        l2_run$run <- i
        l2_run <- l2_run[order(l2_run$run, l2_run$p1_rank), , drop=FALSE]
        l2_worst100_results[[i]] <- l2_run

        total_seconds <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), run_start, units="secs"))
        timing[[i]] <- data.frame(run=i, seed=seed, p1_seconds=p1_time, p2_seconds=p2_time, total_seconds=total_seconds)

        last_completed_run <- i
        save(variable_results, l1_sex_dis_results, l1_age_dis_results, l1_dis_marginal_results,
            l1_dis_hh_results, l2_worst100_results, global_fit_results, timing, last_completed_run,
            file=state_file)
        writeLines(as.character(last_completed_run), file.path(results_dir, "last_completed_run.txt"))

        if(i %% save_every==0 || i==n) {
          checkpoint <- file.path(results_dir, "checkpoints", paste0("run_", id))
          dir.create(checkpoint, showWarnings=FALSE)
          file.copy(p1_pop, checkpoint, overwrite=TRUE)
          file.copy(p1_val, checkpoint, overwrite=TRUE)
          file.copy(p2_pop, checkpoint, overwrite=TRUE)
          file.copy(p2_val, checkpoint, overwrite=TRUE)
        } else {
          file.remove(p1_pop, p1_val, p2_pop, p2_val)
        }

        rm(p1, p2, p1_m, p2_m, m, p1_ids, p2_ids, p1_freq, p2_freq, idx1, idx2, counts1, counts2,
          sex_dis_run, age_dis_run, hh_dis_run, p1_stat, p2_stat)
        gc()
      }

    # 2.12 aggregate post-loop
      sex_dis_all <- do.call(rbind, l1_sex_dis_results)
      age_dis_all <- do.call(rbind, l1_age_dis_results)
      dis_marg_all <- do.call(rbind, l1_dis_marginal_results)
      hh_dis_all <- do.call(rbind, l1_dis_hh_results)

      write.csv(sex_dis_all, file.path(results_dir, "l1_sex_x_disability_by_run.csv"), row.names=FALSE)
      write.csv(age_dis_all, file.path(results_dir, "l1_age_x_disability_by_run.csv"), row.names=FALSE)
      write.csv(dis_marg_all, file.path(results_dir, "l1_disability_marginal_by_run.csv"), row.names=FALSE)
      write.csv(hh_dis_all, file.path(results_dir, "l1_disability_x_household_by_run.csv"), row.names=FALSE)

      dis_marg_avg <- data.frame(
        census_prevalence=mean(dis_marg_all$census_prevalence, na.rm=TRUE),
        p1_prevalence=mean(dis_marg_all$p1_prevalence, na.rm=TRUE),
        p2_prevalence=mean(dis_marg_all$p2_prevalence, na.rm=TRUE),
        p1_minus_census=mean(dis_marg_all$p1_minus_census, na.rm=TRUE),
        p2_minus_census=mean(dis_marg_all$p2_minus_census, na.rm=TRUE),
        p2_minus_p1=mean(dis_marg_all$p2_minus_p1, na.rm=TRUE)
      )
      p1_ci <- ci_from_runs(dis_marg_all$p1_prevalence)
      p2_ci <- ci_from_runs(dis_marg_all$p2_prevalence)
      dis_marg_avg$p1_ci_low <- p1_ci[1]; dis_marg_avg$p1_ci_high <- p1_ci[2]
      dis_marg_avg$p2_ci_low <- p2_ci[1]; dis_marg_avg$p2_ci_high <- p2_ci[2]
      write.csv(dis_marg_avg, file.path(results_dir, "l1_disability_marginal_avg.csv"), row.names=FALSE)

      global_fit_all <- do.call(rbind, global_fit_results)
      fwrite(global_fit_all, file.path(results_dir, "global_fit_by_run.csv"))

      global_fit_metrics <- c("mean_p2_minus_p1_abs","mean_p2_minus_p1_squared","mean_p1_census_abs",
                              "mean_p1_census_squared","mean_p2_census_abs","mean_p2_census_squared")
      global_fit_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(global_fit_metrics, function(metric) {
        x <- global_fit_all[[metric]]
        ci <- ci_from_runs(x)
        data.frame(metric=metric, mean_across_runs=mean(x, na.rm=TRUE), ci_low=ci[1], ci_high=ci[2], n_runs=sum(!is.na(x)))
      }))
      rownames(global_fit_summary) <- NULL
      write.csv(global_fit_summary, file.path(results_dir, "global_fit_summary.csv"), row.names=FALSE)

      timing_all <- do.call(rbind, timing)
      write.csv(timing_all, file.path(results_dir, "timing_by_run.csv"), row.names=FALSE)

      cat("\n[", basename(results_dir), "] COMPLETE — ", n, " runs.\n", sep="")

      invisible(list(dis_marg_avg = dis_marg_avg, global_fit_summary = global_fit_summary))
      }

# STEP 3 - Run for full England - set n_runs/n_populations here 
    n_stochastic_runs <- 10
    null_mode <- FALSE     # TRUE = disability constraint only; FALSE = all constraints

    # experiment settings for this run

    dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

      if (null_mode) {

        ids  <- intersect(c("LSOA21CD", "population"), names(p1_full))
        run_p1_con <- p1_full[, c(ids, keep)]
        run_p2_con <- p2_full[, c(ids, keep)]

        run_p2_grp <- master_p2_groups[master_p2_groups$heading %in% keep, ]

        # trimmed microdata: household id + disability columns only
        trim_micro <- function(in_file, out_file) {

        run_p2_grp <- merge_dis(run_p2_grp)
      }

    # Average constraints 
      ci_from_runs <- function(x) {
        x <- x[!is.na(x)]
        if (length(x) < 2) return(c(ci_low = NA_real_, ci_high = NA_real_))
        q <- quantile(x, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
        c(ci_low = unname(q[1]), ci_high = unname(q[2]))
      }

      summarise_col <- function(x) {
        ci <- ci_from_runs(x)
        list(mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), ci_low = ci["ci_low"], ci_high = ci["ci_high"])
      }

      average_by_run <- function(in_file, out_file, by_cols) {
        dt <- fread(file.path(results_dir, in_file))

        avg <- dt[, {
          p1 <- summarise_col(p1_prevalence)
          p2 <- summarise_col(p2_prevalence)
          gap <- summarise_col(p2_minus_p1)
          .(
            n_runs           = .N,
            p1_prevalence    = p1$mean, p1_ci_low = p1$ci_low, p1_ci_high = p1$ci_high,
            p2_prevalence    = p2$mean, p2_ci_low = p2$ci_low, p2_ci_high = p2$ci_high,
            p2_minus_p1      = gap$mean, p2_minus_p1_ci_low = gap$ci_low, p2_minus_p1_ci_high = gap$ci_high
          )
        }, by = by_cols]

        setorderv(avg, by_cols)
        # print(avg)
        fwrite(avg, file.path(results_dir, out_file))
        invisible(avg)
      }

      # Individuals 
        # Age 
          average_by_run("l1_age_x_disability_by_run.csv", "l1_disability_x_ind_age_avg.csv", "category")
        # Sex 
          average_by_run("l1_sex_x_disability_by_run.csv", "l1_disability_x_ind_sex_avg.csv", "category")
      # Household (skips if in null mode)
        if (!null_mode) {
          average_by_run("l1_disability_x_household_by_run.csv", "l1_disability_x_household_avg.csv", c("variable", "category"))
        } 

  # Compare results 
    library(data.table)
    rd <- function(f) fread(file.path(results_dir, f))

    # Overall
    ov <- rd("l1_disability_marginal_avg.csv")
    overall <- data.table(group = "Overall", category = "All",
                          census = ov$census_prevalence, p1 = ov$p1_prevalence, p2 = ov$p2_prevalence)

    # By sex
    sex <- merge(rd("census_sex_x_disability.csv")[, .(category, census = census_prevalence)],
                rd("l1_disability_x_ind_sex_avg.csv")[, .(category, p1 = p1_prevalence, p2 = p2_prevalence)],
                by = "category")
    sex[, group := "Sex"]
    sex[, category := c(f = "Female", m = "Male")[category]]

    # By age
    age <- merge(rd("census_age_x_disability.csv")[, .(category, census = census_prevalence)],
                rd("l1_disability_x_ind_age_avg.csv")[, .(category, p1 = p1_prevalence, p2 = p2_prevalence)],
                by = "category")
    age[, group := "Age"]
    age[, category := sub("65p", "65+", sub("_", "–", category))]

    # Combine, as percentages
    tab <- rbind(overall, sex, age, use.names = TRUE)
    tab[, `:=`(p1_minus_census = p1 - census, p2_minus_p1 = p2 - p1)]
    num <- c("census", "p1", "p2", "p1_minus_census", "p2_minus_p1")
    tab[, (num) := lapply(.SD, function(x) round(100 * x, 1)), .SDcols = num]
    setcolorder(tab, c("group", "category"))

    print(tab)
    fwrite(tab, file.path(results_dir, "disability_prevalence_table.csv"))
```

```{r investigate p1 - census discrepancy}
    s  <- merge(pop, micro[, c("hidp", dc), with = FALSE], by.x = "microdata_id", by.y = "hidp")
    c(direct = sum(s[, ..d1]) / sum(s[, ..dc]), matched = nrow(s) == nrow(pop))
    # Results
    # This works. Cosine only compares the proportions across cells, ignoring overall size, so inflated count doesn' tmatter.
    # (whereas euclidean distance compares raw counts, so size mismatch affects which hh it picks) 
    # house count issue may still persist 
    # next: check for errors hiding within close overall fit 
  # check for errors across age groups
    dc_age <- sub("^.*%[fm]_(.*)_dis[01]$", "\\1", dc)
    d1_age <- sub("^.*%[fm]_(.*)_dis1$", "\\1", d1)
    cen <- as.data.table(master_p1_constraints)[get(names(master_p1_constraints)[1]) %in% unique(pop$area_id)]

    p1    <- rowsum(colSums(s[, ..d1]), d1_age) / rowsum(colSums(s[, ..dc]), dc_age)
    cen_p <- rowsum(colSums(cen[, ..d1]), d1_age) / rowsum(colSums(cen[, ..dc]), dc_age)
    round(cbind(p1 = p1, census = cen_p, gap_pp = 100 * (p1 - cen_p)), 3)
    # Results 
    # overshooting kids in P1, likely b/c definition doesn't include 'limiting' limitation 
    # undershooting teens, likely b/c student halls aren't included in survey data/P1. 
    # otherwise, within 1%. 
    # P1 benchmark now looking in good shape!!

      labs(x = "Census fraction", y = "P1 synthetic fraction")
      # Results

      # White ethnicity fits ok, others not. 
      # Main cloud is steeper than the line, so larger cells are overfilled, small ones are underfilled. 
      # also a few right side outliers (might be student halls or care homes)
      # next: figure out which household type is which band by coloring them
  # color HHs 
    ggplot(v[group == "hh_type"], aes(constraint_fraction, synth_fraction, colour = variable)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.7) +
      geom_abline(linetype = 2) +
      labs(x = "Census fraction", y = "P1 synthetic fraction", colour = NULL) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical")
      # Results 
      # P1 is overfilling with one-person households 
      # disability is more common among one-person hhs; so hh type isn't behind the disability underestimate in P1
      # HH fit itself is poor, maybe connected to the hh count problem 
      # next: check non/disabled cells by coloring them 
  # color disability cats 
    sad <- v[group == "ind_sex_age_dis"]
    sad[, dis := ifelse(grepl("_dis1$", variable), "disabled", "not disabled")]
    sad[, age := sub("^.*%[fm]_(.*)_dis[01]$", "\\1", variable)]

    ggplot(sad, aes(constraint_fraction, synth_fraction, colour = age)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.7) +
      geom_abline(linetype = 2) +
      facet_wrap(~ dis, scales = "free") +
      labs(x = "Census fraction", y = "P1 synthetic fraction", colour = "Age")
```

```{r box plots}
# Box plots for absolute numbers 
  # Judge fit by LSOAs, not aggregated national total. 
  # Want to show for each LSOA how far each age/sex/dis cell's synthetic share is from the census share
  # x axis: age group
  # y axis: synthetic share minus census chare (in pp)
  # colour: non/dis
  # panels: m/f

  library(data.table); library(ggplot2)
  # built from p1_pop 
  pop   <- rd("p1_pop_run001.csv")
  micro <- fread(p1_micro)   # the microdata file this run used
  dc    <- grep("^ind_sex_age_dis%", names(micro), value = TRUE)

  # Synthetic count and share per LSOA and cell
  s   <- merge(pop, micro[, c("hidp", dc), with = FALSE], by.x = "microdata_id", by.y = "hidp")
  syn <- melt(s[, lapply(.SD, sum), by = area_id, .SDcols = dc],
              id.vars = "area_id", variable.name = "cell", value.name = "syn_n")
  syn[, syn_frac := syn_n / sum(syn_n), by = area_id]

  # Census count and share per LSOA and cell
  con <- as.data.table(master_p1_constraints); id <- names(con)[1]
  cen <- melt(con[get(id) %in% syn$area_id, c(id, dc), with = FALSE],
              id.vars = id, variable.name = "cell", value.name = "cen_n")
  setnames(cen, id, "area_id")
  cen[, cen_frac := cen_n / sum(cen_n), by = area_id]

  d <- merge(syn, cen, by = c("area_id", "cell"))
  d[, diff_pp := 100 * (syn_frac - cen_frac)]
  d[, diff_n  := syn_frac * sum(cen_n) - cen_n, by = area_id]   # synthetic scaled to census population

  x <- sub("^ind_sex_age_dis%", "", d$cell)
  d[, sex := ifelse(substr(x, 1, 1) == "f", "Female", "Male")]
  d[, dis := ifelse(grepl("_dis1$", x), "Disabled", "Not disabled")]
  d[, age := factor(sub("65p", "65+", sub("_", "–", sub("^[fm]_(.*)_dis[01]$", "\\1", x))),
                    levels = c("00–15", "16–24", "25–34", "35–49", "50–64", "65+"))]

  # Figure
  ggplot(d, aes(age, diff_pp, fill = dis)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4, outlier.alpha = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ sex) +
    labs(x = "Age group", y = "Synthetic − census share (percentage points)", fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  # Summary to go with it
  d[, .(mean_abs_pp = round(mean(abs(diff_pp)), 2),
        median_pp   = round(median(diff_pp), 2),
        mean_abs_n  = round(mean(abs(diff_n)), 1)), by = .(dis, age)][order(dis, age)]

fit_by_type <- function(dir) {
  v <- fread(file.path(dir, "p1_validate_run001.csv"))[grepl("^hh_type%", variable)]
  v[, .(mean_abs_pp = round(100 * mean(abs(synth_fraction - constraint_fraction)), 2)), by = variable]
}
merge(fit_by_type("results_full_test_cosine_imputed"),
      fit_by_type("results_full_test_cosine_imputed_noheating"),   # use your actual folder name
      by = "variable", suffixes = c("_with_heating", "_no_heating"))
```

```{r dated - scatter plots}
      plot_fit_scatter <- function(pop = "p1", run = 1, dir = results_dir) {

        id <- sprintf("%03d", run)
        dt <- fread(file.path(dir, paste0(pop, "_validate_run", id, ".csv")))
        dt <- dt[grepl("^ind_sex_age_dis%", variable) &
                 !is.na(synth_fraction) & !is.na(constraint_fraction)]

        # split e.g. "f_00_15_dis1" into sex / age / disability
        dt[, category   := sub("^[^%]*%", "", variable)]
        dt[, sex        := ifelse(substr(category, 1, 1) == "f", "Female", "Male")]
        dt[, disability := ifelse(grepl("_dis1$", category), "Disabled", "Not disabled")]
        dt[, age        := sub("^[fm]_(.*)_dis[01]$", "\\1", category)]

        mse <- dt[, mean((synth_fraction - constraint_fraction)^2)]
        lim <- max(dt$synth_fraction, dt$constraint_fraction)

        p <- ggplot(dt, aes(x = constraint_fraction, y = synth_fraction, colour = age)) +
          geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.4) +
          geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linewidth = 1) +
          geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE,
                      colour = "red", linewidth = 1) +
          facet_grid(sex ~ disability) +
          coord_equal(xlim = c(0, lim), ylim = c(0, lim), expand = FALSE) +
          labs(x = "relative frequency in constraint table",
               y = "relative frequency in synthetic population",
               title = paste0(toupper(pop), " — age / sex / disability, run ", run),
               caption = paste0("Geography: LSOA | MSE of ", sprintf("%.6f", mse),
                                " | unweighted by population size of areas"),
               colour = "Age band") +
          theme_classic()

        ggsave(file.path(dir, paste0(pop, "_scatter_sex_age_dis_run", id, ".jpeg")),
               plot = p, units = "cm", width = 20, height = 20)
        print(p)
        invisible(p)
      }

      plot_fit_scatter("p1")
```

```{r dated - LSOAs}
# LSOAs
  # interpret_worst_lsoas.R
  # Summarizes l2_worst100_by_run: which constraint variables most often show up
  # among the top-5 error drivers for the worst-fitting LSOAs, how large their
  # errors typically are, and whether the pattern is concentrated (one variable
  # dominating) or spread out (broadly poor fit).

  library(data.table)

  l2 <- fread("results_full/l2_worst100_by_run.csv")

  summarise_side <- function(dt, side) {
    var_cols <- paste0(side, "_top", 1:5, "_variable")
    err_cols <- paste0(side, "_top", 1:5, "_error")

    long <- rbindlist(lapply(1:5, function(k) {
      dt[, .(geography_code, run,
            rank_slot = k,
            variable = get(var_cols[k]),
            error = get(err_cols[k]))]
    }))
    long <- long[!is.na(variable)]

    summary <- long[, .(
      n_appearances   = .N,                                  # how often this variable shows up in ANY top-5 slot
      n_unique_lsoas  = uniqueN(geography_code),              # across how many distinct worst-LSOAs
      mean_abs_error  = mean(abs(error)),
      mean_error      = mean(error),                          # sign matters: consistently negative = under-assigned
      pct_top1        = mean(rank_slot == 1) * 100,           # how often it's the single WORST driver, not just present
      side            = side
    ), by = variable]

    setorder(summary, -n_appearances)
    summary
  }

  p1_summary <- summarise_side(l2, "p1")
  p2_summary <- summarise_side(l2, "p2")

  cat("=== P1: variables most often driving the worst-100 LSOAs ===\n")
  print(head(p1_summary, 15))

  cat("\n=== P2: variables most often driving the worst-100 LSOAs ===\n")
  print(head(p2_summary, 15))

  fwrite(p1_summary, "results_full/worst_lsoa_variable_summary_p1.csv")
  fwrite(p2_summary, "results_full/worst_lsoa_variable_summary_p2.csv")

  # concentration check: what share of ALL top-5 appearances does the single
  # most common variable account for? High = one variable dominates the
  # worst-fit cases; low = errors are broadly spread across many constraints.
  cat("\nP1 concentration: top variable accounts for ",
      round(100 * p1_summary$n_appearances[1] / sum(p1_summary$n_appearances), 1),
      "% of all top-5 appearances\n", sep = "")
  cat("P2 concentration: top variable accounts for ",
      round(100 * p2_summary$n_appearances[1] / sum(p2_summary$n_appearances), 1),
      "% of all top-5 appearances\n", sep = "")


  # hh_type_dis_by_age.R
  # Tests whether age confounds the disability x household-type pattern by
  # computing disability prevalence WITHIN each household type, separately
  # for each age band, across all completed runs. If the household-type gaps
  # (e.g. one-person=23% vs couple-with-children=6%) shrink substantially once
  # age is held constant, that confirms age was driving most/all of the raw
  # association. If gaps persist within age bands, there's a real household-
  # type effect beyond age alone.

  library(data.table)
  library(jsonlite)

  results_dir <- "results_full"

  master_p1_constraints <- read.csv("data/England/census2021_e_go_10.csv", check.names=FALSE)
  master_p1_groups      <- read.csv("data/England/groups_e_10.csv", check.names=FALSE)
  master_p1_microdata   <- "data/England/us_hh_export_e_go_10.csv"

  master_p2_constraints <- read.csv("data/England/census2021_e_go_10_sim.csv", check.names=FALSE)
  master_p2_groups      <- read.csv("data/England/groups_e_10_sim.csv", check.names=FALSE)
  master_p2_microdata   <- "data/England/us_hh_export_e_go_10_sim.csv"

  age_bands <- c("00_15", "16_24", "25_34", "35_49", "50_64", "65p")
  hh_level_prefixes <- c("hh_type")   # focus on household type; add "hh_urban_rural","hh_heating" if wanted too

  p1_micro_df <- read.csv(master_p1_microdata, check.names=FALSE)
  p2_micro_df <- read.csv(master_p2_microdata, check.names=FALSE)

  hh_level_cols <- names(p1_micro_df)[sapply(strsplit(names(p1_micro_df), "%"), function(x) x[1]) %in% hh_level_prefixes]

  dis_cols_all <- names(p1_micro_df)[grepl("^ind_sex_age_dis%", names(p1_micro_df))]

  p1_lookup_mat <- as.matrix(p1_micro_df[, c(dis_cols_all, hh_level_cols), drop=FALSE])
  p2_lookup_mat <- as.matrix(p2_micro_df[, c(dis_cols_all, hh_level_cols), drop=FALSE])
  rownames(p1_lookup_mat) <- as.character(p1_micro_df$hidp)
  rownames(p2_lookup_mat) <- as.character(p2_micro_df$hidp)

  prevalence_weighted <- function(mat, idx, counts, dis1_cols_sub, dis0_cols_sub) {
    if(length(idx)==0 || length(c(dis1_cols_sub, dis0_cols_sub))==0) {
      return(data.frame(dis1_count=0, pop_count=0, prevalence=NA_real_))
    }
    cols <- c(dis1_cols_sub, dis0_cols_sub)
    sub <- mat[idx, cols, drop=FALSE] * counts
    dis1_n <- sum(sub[, dis1_cols_sub, drop=FALSE], na.rm=TRUE)
    pop_n <- sum(sub, na.rm=TRUE)
    data.frame(dis1_count=dis1_n, pop_count=pop_n, prevalence=ifelse(pop_n>0, dis1_n/pop_n, NA_real_))
  }

  # find all completed run population files
  p1_pop_files <- list.files(results_dir, pattern="^p1_pop_run\\d+\\.csv$", full.names=TRUE)
  run_ids <- gsub(".*run(\\d+)\\.csv$", "\\1", p1_pop_files)

  results <- list()

  for (id in run_ids) {

    p1_pop_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("p1_pop_run", id, ".csv"))
    p2_pop_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("p2_pop_run", id, ".csv"))
    if (!file.exists(p1_pop_file) || !file.exists(p2_pop_file)) next  # only checkpointed runs kept both files

    p1_ids <- fread(p1_pop_file, select="microdata_id")[[1]]
    p2_ids <- fread(p2_pop_file, select="microdata_id")[[1]]
    p1_freq <- table(as.character(p1_ids))
    p2_freq <- table(as.character(p2_ids))
    idx1 <- match(names(p1_freq), rownames(p1_lookup_mat))
    idx2 <- match(names(p2_freq), rownames(p2_lookup_mat))
    counts1 <- as.numeric(p1_freq)
    counts2 <- as.numeric(p2_freq)

    for (pfx in hh_level_prefixes) {
      cats <- hh_level_cols[grepl(paste0("^", pfx, "%"), hh_level_cols)]

      for (col_name in cats) {
        cat_label <- sub("^.*%", "", col_name)
        mask1 <- p1_lookup_mat[idx1, col_name] == 1
        mask2 <- p2_lookup_mat[idx2, col_name] == 1

        # overall (unstratified) prevalence within this household type, for reference
        p1_overall <- prevalence_weighted(p1_lookup_mat, idx1[mask1], counts1[mask1], dis_cols_all[grepl("_dis1$", dis_cols_all)], dis_cols_all[grepl("_dis0$", dis_cols_all)])
        p2_overall <- prevalence_weighted(p2_lookup_mat, idx2[mask2], counts2[mask2], dis_cols_all[grepl("_dis1$", dis_cols_all)], dis_cols_all[grepl("_dis0$", dis_cols_all)])

        results[[length(results)+1]] <- data.table(
          run=id, variable=pfx, category=cat_label, age_band="ALL",
          p1_prevalence=p1_overall$prevalence, p2_prevalence=p2_overall$prevalence
        )

        # age-band-stratified prevalence within this household type
        for (a in age_bands) {
          d1 <- dis_cols_all[grepl(paste0("_", a, "_dis1$"), dis_cols_all)]
          d0 <- dis_cols_all[grepl(paste0("_", a, "_dis0$"), dis_cols_all)]

          p1_stat <- prevalence_weighted(p1_lookup_mat, idx1[mask1], counts1[mask1], d1, d0)
          p2_stat <- prevalence_weighted(p2_lookup_mat, idx2[mask2], counts2[mask2], d1, d0)

          results[[length(results)+1]] <- data.table(
            run=id, variable=pfx, category=cat_label, age_band=a,
            p1_prevalence=p1_stat$prevalence, p2_prevalence=p2_stat$prevalence
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }

  all_results <- rbindlist(results)

  # average across runs
  avg <- all_results[, .(
    p1_prevalence = mean(p1_prevalence, na.rm=TRUE),
    p2_prevalence = mean(p2_prevalence, na.rm=TRUE),
    n_runs = sum(!is.na(p1_prevalence))
  ), by = .(variable, category, age_band)]

  avg[, age_band := factor(age_band, levels = c("ALL", age_bands))]
  setorder(avg, variable, category, age_band)

  print(avg)
  fwrite(avg, file.path(results_dir, "hh_type_disability_by_age_avg.csv"))
```

```{r dated - figures}
  # Individual vars x disability 

  library(ggplot2)

  # ========================================
  # LOAD DATA
  # ========================================

  df <- read.csv("l1_ind_vars_disability_avg.csv", check.names = FALSE)

  # ========================================
  # RESHAPE: one row per (category x process) for point + CI plotting
  # ========================================
  # Note: census has no CI in this dataset, so it gets NA ci_low/ci_high
  # and geom_errorbarh will simply skip drawing a bar for those rows.

  df_long <- df %>%
    select(variable, label,
          census_prevalence,
          p1_prevalence, p1_ci_low, p1_ci_high,
          p2_prevalence, p2_ci_low, p2_ci_high) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(census_prevalence, p1_prevalence, p2_prevalence),
      names_to = "process", values_to = "prevalence"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ci_low  = case_when(
        process == "p1_prevalence" ~ p1_ci_low,
        process == "p2_prevalence" ~ p2_ci_low,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      ci_high = case_when(
        process == "p1_prevalence" ~ p1_ci_high,
        process == "p2_prevalence" ~ p2_ci_high,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      process = case_when(
        process == "census_prevalence" ~ "Census",
        process == "p1_prevalence" ~ "P1",
        process == "p2_prevalence" ~ "P2"
      ),
      process = factor(process, levels = c("Census", "P1", "P2"))
    ) %>%
    select(variable, label, process, prevalence, ci_low, ci_high)

  # ========================================
  # CONNECTING SEGMENTS: span min-to-max of the three estimates per category
  # ========================================

  df_segments <- df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      x_min = min(census_prevalence, p1_prevalence, p2_prevalence),
      x_max = max(census_prevalence, p1_prevalence, p2_prevalence)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # ========================================
  # PLOT
  # ========================================

  p <- ggplot() +
    # connecting line spanning the full range of the three estimates, per category
    geom_segment(
      data = df_segments,
      aes(x = x_min, xend = x_max, y = label, yend = label),
      color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    # CI error bars (only drawn for P1 / P2, since census has no CI here)
    geom_errorbarh(
      data = df_long,
      aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high, y = label, color = process),
      height = 0.15, linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    # the estimates themselves

      aes(x = prevalence, y = label, color = process),
```

```{r dated - fit check}
# Fit check
  # ========================================
  # COMPARE DISABILITY CONSTRAINT FIT VS OTHER CONSTRAINTS
  # Run this after the main loop (or load from state_file / saved CSVs)
  # ========================================

  library(dplyr)
  setwd("C:/Users/Jamie/Documents/compass")
  # ----------------------------------------
  # OPTION A: if variable_results is still in memory (list of per-run data.frames)
  # ----------------------------------------
  # variable_all <- do.call(rbind, variable_results)

  # ----------------------------------------
  # OPTION B: reload from the checkpoint state file
  # ----------------------------------------
  results_dir <- "results_new"
  state_file <- file.path(results_dir, "analysis_state.RData")
  load(state_file)   # brings back variable_results among others

  variable_all <- do.call(rbind, variable_results)

  # ========================================
  # AGGREGATE ACROSS RUNS, PER VARIABLE
  # variable_results already stores summed squared/abs errors and n per run,
  # per variable (from the `aggregate(... ~ variable_p1, ...)` step in the main loop).
  # We sum those sums across all runs, then divide once — i.e. this is itself
  # an absolute-number aggregation, not a mean-of-means, so it's consistent
  # with how the marginal prevalence figures were built.
  # ========================================

  variable_fit <- variable_all %>%
    group_by(variable) %>%
    summarise(
      n_runs = n_distinct(run),
      p1_census_mse   = sum(p1_minus_census_squared_sum, na.rm=TRUE) / sum(p1_minus_census_squared_n, na.rm=TRUE),
      p1_census_mae   = sum(p1_minus_census_abs_sum,     na.rm=TRUE) / sum(p1_minus_census_abs_n,     na.rm=TRUE),
      p2_census_mse   = sum(p2_minus_census_squared_sum, na.rm=TRUE) / sum(p2_minus_census_squared_n, na.rm=TRUE),
      p2_census_mae   = sum(p2_minus_census_abs_sum,     na.rm=TRUE) / sum(p2_minus_census_abs_n,     na.rm=TRUE),
      p2_p1_mse       = sum(p2_minus_p1_squared_sum,     na.rm=TRUE) / sum(p2_minus_p1_squared_n,     na.rm=TRUE),
      p2_p1_mae       = sum(p2_minus_p1_abs_sum,         na.rm=TRUE) / sum(p2_minus_p1_abs_n,         na.rm=TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(p1_census_mae))

  # ========================================
  # FLAG DISABILITY VARIABLES SPECIFICALLY
  # ========================================

  variable_fit <- variable_fit %>%
    mutate(is_disability = grepl("^ind_sex_age_dis", variable))

  # ========================================
  # RANKING — where does disability sit relative to everything else?
  # ========================================

  variable_fit <- variable_fit %>%
    mutate(
      rank_p1_census_mae = rank(-p1_census_mae),
      rank_p2_census_mae = rank(-p2_census_mae)
    )

  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("PER-VARIABLE FIT, RANKED BY P1-vs-CENSUS MAE (worst first)\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  print(variable_fit, n = nrow(variable_fit))

  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("DISABILITY VARIABLES ONLY\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  print(variable_fit %>% filter(is_disability), n = Inf)

  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("SUMMARY: DISABILITY VS ALL OTHER (non-disability) VARIABLES\n")
  cat("========================================\n")

  summary_by_group <- variable_fit %>%
    group_by(is_disability) %>%
    summarise(
      n_vars = n(),
      mean_p1_census_mae = mean(p1_census_mae, na.rm=TRUE),
      mean_p2_census_mae = mean(p2_census_mae, na.rm=TRUE),
      mean_p2_p1_mae     = mean(p2_p1_mae, na.rm=TRUE),
      median_rank_p1_census_mae = median(rank_p1_census_mae, na.rm=TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  print(summary_by_group)

  # ========================================
  # SAVE
  # ========================================

  write.csv(variable_fit, file.path(results_dir, "variable_fit_comparison.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  cat("\nSaved: ", file.path(results_dir, "variable_fit_comparison.csv"), "\n", sep="")
  cat("\nInterpretation guide:\n")
  cat("- If disability's rank_p1_census_mae is near the TOP (i.e. among the worst-fitting\n")
  cat("  variables) relative to other constraints, that points toward an algorithm-fit or\n")
  cat("  constraint-competition explanation (disability is being under-prioritized by the\n")
  cat("  optimizer relative to other simultaneously-fitted constraints).\n")
  cat("- If disability's fit is unremarkable relative to other variables, but the MARGINAL\n")
  cat("  prevalence gap is still large, that points more toward a category-definition /\n")
  cat("  specification issue (e.g. a mismatch in how dis1/dis0 categories are defined\n")
  cat("  or interact with age/sex bands between constraints and microdata) rather than\n")
  cat("  a general algorithm underperformance issue.\n")
```
